title: Constitutional Capital Recovery Index
description: Measures constitutional divergence, suppressed lawful access, and recoverable constitutional capital produced by unlawful gatekeeping systems.

authority.name: A.B.E. — Constitutional Capital Recovery Index (CCRI)
authority.note: CCRI enriches the A.B.E. system and does not replace the pioneer spine.

inputs.description: Each scenario describes one institution or policy environment where DMV, DOT, license, or similar status data may suppress lawful access and constitutional capital.

data_integrity.description: How strictly the system limits itself to lawful, relevant, and minimally intrusive data sources.

constitutional_alignment.description: Whether rules respect supremacy, right to travel, and limits on delegated police power.

access_fairness.description: Whether similarly situated people are treated alike without unlawful status-based gating.

economic_impact.description: Estimated effect on work access, income, and community participation when barriers are imposed.

narrative_templates.high_risk: This system shows severe dependency on unlawful DMV or DOT data for noncommercial access decisions. CCRI classifies it as HIGH DIVERGENCE and high constitutional capital suppression.
narrative_templates.moderate_risk: This system exhibits mixed practices. Some rules diverge from constitutional and federal boundaries. CCRI classifies it as MODERATE DIVERGENCE and a candidate for targeted correction.
narrative_templates.low_risk: This system relies primarily on lawful and relevant criteria. DMV and DOT contamination is low or absent. CCRI classifies it as LOW DIVERGENCE.

downstream_links.purpose: Provides recovery hints and divergence context for risk and injury modeling.
